create_gauge_histogram: create a Prometheus GaugeHistogram with gt/le bucket labels for Grafana heatmap visualization
build_bucket_labels: build non-cumulative bucket label pairs with gt/le ranges from a list of upper bounds
test_compute_bucket_counts: test the BucketLabels compute_bucket_counts method with a list of observations
set_raw_bucket_counts: set raw bucket counts directly on a GaugeHistogram using precomputed values
set_by_current_observations: set bucket counts on a GaugeHistogram by computing from a list of current observations
